newsitem.title: USA: Republic Security to acquire Family Bank.
newsitem.headline: Republic Security to acquire Family Bank.

text.p: Republic Security Financial Corp said on Tuesday it agreed to acquire Family Bank, a commercial bank in Hallandale, Florida, for 7.7 million shares of stock, or approximately $46 million.
Family Bank has assets of $248 million, loans of $159 million and deposits of $216 million.
Republic Security said the agreement is subject to regulatory and shareholder approval and is expected to close in the second quarter of 1997.

As a result of the merger, Republic Security Financial is projected to have total assets of approximately $610 million, total capital of approximately $65 million and more than 15 million shares of common stock outstanding.
The company will conduct business through 17 branch offices, Republic said.
The merger is expected to be immediately accretive to earnings per share, Republic said.
